title: Value Types
description: Learn about C# value types including integers, floats, and structs.

data.text: **Value types** store their data directly. They're stored on the stack and copied when assigned.

data.title: Numeric Types
data.code:
// Integers
byte b = 255;           // 0 to 255
short s = 32767;        // -32,768 to 32,767
int i = 2147483647;     // Most common integer
long l = 9223372036854775807; // Large numbers

// Floating-point
float f = 3.14f;         // 7 digits precision
double d = 3.14159;      // 15-16 digits
decimal m = 3.14159m;    // 28-29 digits (money)

// Character and boolean
char c = 'A';            // Single character
bool flag = true;        // true or false

data.title: Structs
Value Semantics
data.text: When you assign a value type to another variable, a copy is made. Changes to one don't affect the other.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: int, double, bool are value types
